assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background painting for the main menu of an original fantasy card game, Triseal; very wide landscape 16:9, preferably 2560 x 1440.
Primary request: Paint an atmospheric, beautifully crafted drowned observatory, a complete immersive fantasy game environment, with no interface and no lettering.
Scene: an ancient ocean observatory open to a vast luminous teal abyss through soaring eroded Gothic stone arches. An enormous intricate bronze astronomical armillary mechanism is suspended on the RIGHT HALF, centered around x=74%, y=42%, its rings holding a small cyan pearl of light. Delicate ember and pale violet points within the mechanism subtly suggest three magic sigils. Stone stairs and a weathered curved causeway lead from the bottom right toward the instrument. Sea life, luminous tiny plankton and suspended silt make this a mysterious underwater world; submerged ruined towers recede in blue haze. A few small amber lanterns add warm accents on the stone.
Character: one small solitary Chartkeeper seen from behind on the right-side steps near x=67%, y=74%, about 15% of image height: dark teal hooded coat with bronze trim and map-pattern lining, rust-orange scarf drifting sideways, a slender brass staff tipped with soft turquoise light. The character is part of the environment, not a large portrait.
Composition: strong artistic composition with deep layered distance, framing pillars, exquisite hand-painted fantasy illustration. LEFT 40% is a quiet deeply shaded stone alcove and gentle navy atmosphere, low contrast and few details so an independent title and four menu text items can be overlaid there. Still paint natural architectural depth on that left area, no empty black rectangle. Keep essential right-hand architecture and figure visible with modest vertical cropping for phone landscape. Bright focal area on the right, naturally dark left, not a split screen.
Style: premium painterly dark fantasy game key art, visible delicate painted texture, refined edges, rich weathered bronze, wet stone, restrained bioluminescence; dignified wonder and melancholy, not horror; coherent handcrafted illustration, NOT a screenshot, NOT flat vector art, NOT photorealistic 3D.
Palette: deep ink navy, muted sea-green turquoise, antique brass, sparing rust orange and pearl violet.
Text: none.
Constraints: full-bleed opaque landscape illustration only. No typography, no logos, no UI, no cards, no buttons, no borders, no frame, no watermark, no copied game assets, no resemblance to recognizable characters from existing games.
assets.inputs: Original text prompt only; no third-party image inputs.
assets.export: WebP quality 88, maximum width 2400px, no content alterations.
